reviews.text:
I don’t normally write reviews this long, but I had such a genuinely great experience here that I had to. My dog Romy is a young and reactive German Shepherd mix, and after a stressful experience at another vet, I was very nervous about bringing her in. From my very first call with Olivia, I felt like she truly listened to me. She took the time to understand Romy, helped me come up with a plan before the appointment, scheduled us first thing in the morning so she wouldn’t have to be around other dogs, and was SO unbelievably kind and patient with both of us.

When I first met Dr. Meltzer, it was obvious he’s one of those people that you feel comfortable around without him having to try. There was something so warm and gentle about him from the second he walked into the room. What stood out to me most was how naturally he connected with Romy. He never rushed her or made either of us feel like she was difficult. He gave her time, talked to her like she was his own, and made the entire experience feel so playful and safe. We got through her whole exam and blood draw with her calmer than I’ve ever seen her at a vet. His love for animals came through in every little interaction with her.

He also took so much time to answer every question I had, explain things in detail, gave me resources, and made me feel so heard. I never once felt rushed or like he was trying to move on to the next appointment. Even as we were leaving, he noticed another dog coming in and without me even having to ask, he made sure Romy had the space she needed to get outside comfortably without reacting.

After my last soul dog passed away 5 years ago, it took me a long time to feel ready to bring another pupper into my life. I also have a siamese cat, so between the two of them I’ve definitely been through my fair share of vet visits over the years. And I can say with certainty that this level of thoughtfulness and attention is hard to come by.

I walked out feeling like both Romy and I had been truly understood and cared for. I’m incredibly grateful to Olivia, Dr. Meltzer, and the whole team, and I genuinely don’t see myself taking her anywhere else for the rest of our silly goofy love filled lives.

I will never go anywhere else for my dogs care. This place is an absolute gem, and even that is an understatement.They care so much about your animals and give so much time, attention and detail to you. I can’t say enough good things about this place. They were so sweet with my dog, they showed him every instrument and let him sniff before using it and handled him so gently. They explained everything to me from what they were doing and why to his results with such thoroughness and answered all my questions. Everyone here is so sweet and kind too to top it off. I feel so thankful to have found a vet that gives me a peace of mind. My dog also loves going to the vet now, whenever we walk by he wants to go in and when we are there he doesn’t want to leave.

Thank you for the 5-star rating! We appreciate the feedback.

Thanks,
East Village Animal Clinic

They're easy to make an appointment with and they don't make you wait forever in a lobby. Their team is really informative and comprehensive, but not pushy. They always take great care of my kitties. 10/10 would recommend them if you're looking for a vet.
The test in my cat was conducted promptly and the animal appeared calm after.

I had a great experience here with Dr Meltzer and the whole staff. Really nice and down to earth people. The vets I’ve been to always pressure you to run every expensive test under the sun for the sake of it every time. They were really pragmatic here about what’s really necessary at this age, and gave practical next steps for things like managing weight loss and tartar build up at home. I left with a great peace of mind and I’ll definitely be back!

Thank you for the 5-star rating! We appreciate the feedback.

Thanks,
East Village Animal Clinic

I was very pleased to learn that Dr. Meltzer was now the owner of East Village Animal Clinic. I was a customer when it was the Village Veterinarians. My little cat Annabelle is 14+ and quite skittish! Thankfully,  she was in excellent hands! All good for now and I thank Dr. Meltzer and his entire staff!  👏👏👏
Great care as always!! Thank you Dr. Max Meltzer!
Lovely how they say they are walk in n they tell you that they can't take u n its not walk in at this time.... really?!
Excellent experience meeting the friendly very attentive staff, thanks for welcoming me and answering the questions I had, it was a pleasure meeting with you.
I love the decorations and atmosphere overall. They’re all very nice and Dr. Meltzer is down to earth.
I came with two 8 week old nervous feral kittens.   We had a wonderful experience with the entire staff.
I had a good experience Dr Melzer is great and staff. Was very professional  and friendly.
Great clinic with friendly service. Love that Dr. Meltzer is a constant now!!

Our first visit to East Village Animal Clinic was a pleasure.  We were looking for a veterinarian close to our home.
They were professional and understanding of our two terror-stricken cats not accustomed to leaving their home.

I was going to the Village Veterinarian for over 10 plus years before Dr Moscovich retired the practice. Since 2024/2025, the business got sold to private equity, the experience has genuinely been atrocious. My last visit here was fine even though there's zero personalization — they don't try to study before the visits, the vets barely remember them, so they are asking you about the chart — but then when they called me for the Booster appointment reminder and asked me (the pet owner), "what boosters are she coming in for", I kind of lost it. As a pet owner, I'm pretty good at remembering such things and keeping track but why is the Vet asking me all the medical inquiries. They really lost me as a customer here.
Great team that loves the animals and is patient and kind with owners too.

Thank you for your review! We appreciate the 5-star rating.

Thanks,
East Village Animal Clinic

Terrible customer service (May 2026). I took both of my cats to this clinic a year ago for regular check-up and vaccination. The visit was fine and the vets/receptionists were kind and helpful. I was specifically looking to support a small business in the neighborhood I just moved to. One of my cats is on a prescription diet and his food is up for renewal. I called in to ask if they would do a one-time courtesy renewal, before his next appointment and was rudely informed NO, because he's 2 weeks overdue for his annual checkup (mind, no appointment call or reminder was received). Absolutely ridiculous. I will be bringing my business to a new veterinary clinic with better people/customer service skills.

Dr. Meltzer is the best!! Cares for his patients with the utmost integrity and makes sure owners understand everything that is going on and all of their options when next steps are needed. We wouldn't trust Wilma's care with anyone else.
Best vet experience! So smooth and great prices.

Another 5-Star visit with Dr. Meltzer and East Village Animal Clinic! When our pup Bleecker had a hot spot, they were so quick to help solve the problem and get him the right meds to bring him back to 100%. I couldn’t recommend this team more.

Dr. Meltzer and his team provided outstanding care from start to finish. The entire staff was incredibly friendly, thoughtful, and attentive, which made the experience much less stressful for us and our puppy. They took amazing care of her during her spay surgery and made sure we felt informed and comfortable throughout the process. We’re very grateful for their professionalism and compassion, and we highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring veterinary team. 🐶💙

Way too expensive. More so than other vets. In order to get teeth cleaning they insist on. $500 chest xray. Felt the place was cold natured and rushed. Only did blood work and rabies shot. Outrageous prices.

Honestly the best experience!!!!!!!! Took my new puppy over to see Dr Meltzer who was AMAZING !!!!! Caring, friendly, and genital. Office was CLEAN, the staff was supper nice, and helpful. Could not be happier... 10 STARS ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Dr Meltzer is the most attentive and professional veterinarian in NYC. He listens. He doesn’t pad the bill with unneeded tests. The opposite. He’ll show your holistic treatments if they can do the same as over-the-counter treatments.
I can not recommend him enough!

Abe, thank you for the 5-star rating! We appreciate you choosing us! If there is anything else we can do to help please let us know!

Thanks,
East Village Animal Clinic

I recently moved from Ireland to New York with my 7 year old rescue Greyhound, Picasso. He doesn’t particularly love going to the vets and I needed to get him a vaccine. From the first email I sent to East Village Animal Clinic explaining how nervous and timid Picasso can be they put me at ease. Picasso has been to the clinic twice now for vaccinations and both times every single member of staff we’ve interacted with from the receptionists to the vet nurses to veterinarians have been so patient and friendly. Great clinic!
Friendly compassionate knowledgeable staff

My dog has been a patient of EVAC (formerly Village Vet) for over a year. I’ve met essentially all of the staff and everyone is so kind, patient, and understanding. My rescue dog is terrified of even walking in, but they’re always so accommodating & gentle with him. Dr. Meltzer, KaryAnn, Juan, Amanda, etc. thank you! Can’t recommend enough in the neighborhood.

Not sure why this place has so many stars but I didn’t like the vibe from the employees. I brought my cat here last minute last week because she needed to be seen urgently. I understand that they were almost closed but the way she informed me seemed very insensitive and lacked empathy and compassion. She didn’t even care that I was under stress, probably didn’t even process what I was saying because she couldn’t wait to say the script “sorry we’re closed”. She had a slight smirk on her face. Not sure what her name was but she was blond.

Sadly my cat passed away yesterday, so I called to inquire about the price of cremation. They had the nerve to say we need to schedule an appointment for that. I’m sorry, excuse me???? How does that make any logical sense?? Why would people have to book an appointment to have their deceased cat be cremated???? They were the ONLY vet in my area that had that strange policy. Everywhere else was walk in (thankfully) and the clerk seemed very compassionate and empathetic at the other vet I went to.

Seems that the clerk from East Village Animal Clinic is just there for a check. I think people who lack basic empathy and compassion should work where they don’t have to encounter animals or people. This obviously isn’t your passion and your body language screams “I don’t care”. Disgusting and will never recommend this place even if it was the last place standing.

Great experience at EVAC.    Dr Meltzer listened and answered my questions.   He  got down on the floor to calm my anxious pitties and explained  the treatment that I needed to continue at home till I actually understood it.   Further more I didn’t feel robbed when I paid the bill.  I finally found a Vet I can trust,  one who actually loves his patients!

Switching to East Village Animal Clinic has been one of the best decisions I’ve made for my dog’s care. Dr. Max Meltzer is incredibly informative, compassionate, and unlike any vet I’ve ever worked with before. He took the time to truly explain my dog’s critical IVDD situation in a way that eased my anxiety, and his calm, kind demeanor immediately made me feel safe and supported. The entire team has created such a welcoming environment for us, highly recommend this clinic and Dr. Meltzer to anyone seeking a vet who goes above and beyond.

We couldn't be happier or more relieved to have found Dr. Meltzer at his new practice in the East Village. We were previously his clients at his First Avenue clinic, where he provided the most incredible care for our senior terrier, Ellie.

During a difficult time, Dr. Meltzer's approach to end-of-life care was nothing short of amazing. He managed to blend a scientific understanding of her needs with a compassionate balance with her quality of life. His team coordinated with her specialists, which took a huge weight off our shoulders and allowed us to focus on time with Ellie. His guidance and support were invaluable.

We now have a new, little guy called Timo, and there was no question who we would trust with his care. We are so glad to be back with Dr. Meltzer and highly recommend his practice to any pet owner looking for a knowledgeable, thoughtful, and truly caring veterinarian.

BEWARE OF DR. MAX MELTZER!
He was at the 1st avenue veterinary hospital where our beloved cat was MISDIAGNOSED TWICE as having a dental issue when the real diagnosis was ORAL CANCER. That practice has closed and that is why this review is being placed here. The diagnosis of ORAL CANCER was made by a animal dentist after waiting for a month for that appointment, who was shocked at our cat's horrible medical presentation and offered to have our cat put down on the spot due to the severity of the CANCER. During the wait time of one month for the animal dentist my beloved cat was DYING in front of our eyes and suffering as was my family watching this horror play out, under the MISDIAGNOSIS that our cat needed dental care. During the month that we were waiting in ANGUISH, our BELOVED SUFFERED so much that the cat, Speed, was brought back to MELTZER twice who again missed the ORAL CANCER and told us to hang in there as we needed an animal dentist and they are busy so we had to wait. Our beloved Speed was taken home from the animal dentist where we now faced telling our son, who was at school, that his best friend needed to be put down immediately . Our SON had NO PREPARATION for this event due to the doctor's misdiagnosis. Our son SUFFERED and couldn't say GOODBYE to his life long buddy due the extent of the Speed's SUFFERING. REMEMBER, we were waiting on a dentist for a month so preparations could have been made with my son if we had a accurate diagnosis and SPEED would have been put down, instead of suffering in PAIN for ONE MONTH. SPEED was put down the next day by the GOOD PEOPLE at the ANIMAL MEDICAL CENTER. When MELTZER was confronted, ALL HE SAID WAS THAT "SPEED WOULD HAVE BEEN PUT DOWN ANYWAY". That was is a HORRIBLE response VOID of empathy and responsibility, he never said he was SORRY and had no acknowledgement of our beloved's suffering or our family pain that we were watching our beloved SPEED DYING IN FRONT OFF OUR EYES for over ONE MONTH, has left us with MEMORIES OF TRUAMA. THIS COULD HAPPEN TO YOU AND YOUR LOVED ONE. I have never personally written an online review before. I have had my own experience of trauma from this event and it has taken me a lot to find the strength to confront this issue and write this review. I hope something like this never happens to you or your beloved. STAY AWAY!!  Jason

So gentle and sweet with my Mr. Handsome. They were able to accommodate me and him and my cat didn’t make a fuss because they were so calm, quick, and professional. 10/10. I’m Mr. Handsome is excited for his next visit.
We love EVAC and so does our morkie! Great service and care. Best in the neighborhood (and beyond).
Dr. Meltzer was beyond incredible and treated our pup with such love & care! I couldn’t recommend EV animal clinic more. The office was so efficient with our visit!
Dr. Meltzer is such an amazing Vet and made me and our dog Doug feel so cared for! Love this office and staff.

Dr. Meltzer is the best vet in the city! Exceptional bedside manner, he cares deeply about every animal he cares for, and he does his best to be transparent with their owners. I couldn’t recommend him more.

Truly the best experience I’ve had with a veterinarian office! I took my anxious cat here for the first time today and could not be happier with the care she received. Dr. Meltzer and the entire team were extremely professional, knowledgeable, and kind. They really went above and beyond in caring for my cat. Will always come back here!
They provide excellent care for my dog and cat! Highly recommended.

My wife and I bring our eight year old Rottweiler, Maggy, here for care and check ups. So far, so good. I'd even say Maggy enjoys the visits! Everyone is friendly and we feel we receive honest quotes for treatment.

I couldn’t be happier with Dr. Meltzer and the entire staff at East Village Animal Clinic. Dr. Meltzer is one of the most caring and thorough veterinarians I’ve ever met. He genuinely takes the time to understand not only his patients, but also the concerns of pet owners.

This was my second time to the east village animal clinic, and it’s clear that the entire team truly loves what they do. I’ve tried 2 other vets in the city and I’m so glad we finally found a team that we trust to care for our three cats. Dr. Meltzer is the most perfect combination of evidence based medicine, kindness, and integrity.

Highly recommend to anyone looking for a vet who truly gets it.

I wanted to be excited about this new staff, but have been incredibly disappointed. Ran to the clinic after my dog got ahold of a rodent in the park and when I asked for information / precautions I should take, they said they were booked (I didn’t ask for a room) and I was treated like I had 3 heads for even bringing my dog there. The receptionist was incredibly rude and laughed at me when I said she could have just informed me. It was like I had mistakenly not walked into a vet lol. I called a second vet and they were able to take 60 seconds to educate me on how to treat my pup, who isn’t even a patient there. We will be switching care, RIP to the old village vet you will be missed!

We had such a great experience with Dr. Meltzer that we followed him when he moved here. Our dog is usually nervous at the vet, but Dr. Meltzer is so patient and caring, and our dog was calm and comfortable throughout. Would highly recommend him!

I have a 70 pound Rottweiler and everyone loves her. The vets are so professional. Reception is warm and welcoming. So far this is my favorite vet I’ve been to. My dog definitely agrees- she is always so excited about her vet visits.
Great experience, nice staff, Dr. Meltzer went above and beyond to explain my dogs cherry eye problem and offer recommendations. Not to mention my dog , Jrue loves him!

So glad I found an amazing vet in my neighborhood! Such nice staff and on the second visit everyone knew my dogs name. After a vaccine reaction the vets took extra care with Pete & made sure that he was doing well! Highly recommend the Village Veterinarian!

I think the assistant was much more pleasanter. I feel the vet was in a rush.  He didn't allow questions. He was cold and distant. The assistant was much more pleasanter and available. I felt the vet was in a rush and I need to find another vet.  Thanks. My sweet Georgio.

We've been loyal Village Vet clients since 2014, when Dr. Murphy was a beloved veterinarian. She was exceptional - honest, patient, and always willing to research answers to our questions.
However, this past summer, our experience drastically changed after Village Vet was acquired by a new company. The clinic then had no doctors and had a rotation of temporary vets.

Our recent visit for a routine checkup and vaccinations was a nightmare. The front desk staff was rude and dismissive. We specifically requested that a shot not be administered to our dog's injured leg, but it was given there anyway. I noticed during the exam that my dog was whining in the exam room. I asked the receptionist where they administered the shot when she came out, and she said the rear end, so I asked the vet tech who came out after where he put the shot, and he said on his left shoulder. The staff lied about the injection site and seemed more concerned with covering up their mistake than addressing our concerns. I am not sure why a receptionist would even answer this question without even asking the vet tech.

The front desk manager tried to rectify the situation, but a few days later, we received a call stating that our dog's blood sample had been mishandled and had been out for too long, rendering it unusable. The clinic blamed the lab, but we find this explanation unconvincing.

We had to bring our dog back for another appointment, but this time, I insisted on being present during the exam to ensure our dog's safety.

During the follow-up visit, three technicians crowded into the small exam room, and if you have been village vet the exam rooms are tiny and very claustrophobic. One of the technicians had her feet up on the exam table before we entered while scrolling through her phone. The table was dirty, and the technicians were careless and unprofessional and did not even clean the table when we got there.

The final straw was when the technician botched the follow-up injection, missing the skin and spilling medication onto our dog's fur. They displayed no remorse and offered no apology, and they did not even clean up the medication that spilled onto my dog.

I emailed Lordane, the manager, after, and he was silent.

Please be very careful about this place. Seeing how they treated us, we can't imagine how they treat the animals behind closed doors. Seeing how three vet technicians could not handle a basic shot shows the level of experience.

I am not huge fan writing negative reviews, but I would never want another pet parent having to deal with this and to put their animals in harm.

We also learned the new veterinarian that is permanent just graduated veterinarian school so I don't believe there is a lot of experience there. Definitely, not the experience Dr. Murphy had.
We're sorry to hear of your experience, Nancy. A team member from our management team will be reaching out to further understand how we can improve your next experience with The Village Veterinarian.

Your 5-star review truly made our day, Sabrina! It means the world to us that you trust The Village Veterinarian with your pet’s care. We’ll continue working hard to provide exceptional service and look forward to seeing you both again soon.
the best of the best and the receptionist is a doll.  both Calhoun Wolfe and myself love the Dr's and staff.  Quality care done with genius and love

Camille, thank you for such kind words! Your pet’s well-being is our highest priority, and knowing that you had such a positive experience with us at The Village Veterinarian brings us so much joy. We’re here for you and your pet, and we look forward to seeing you both again!
The best, most compassionate, thoughtful and collaborative care.  Through the entire lifespan of our dog Dory, she was in the best hands with the whole team at Village Veterinarian.
As always, the staff at the Village Veterinarian went above and beyond to help me and my sick dog.
I have taken my dog here for years - since he was a newborn puppy. They are very thorough and kind

Thank you so much, Queury, for the review! We’re thrilled to know that your experience at The Village Veterinarian was a positive one. It’s always a joy to see you and your pet, and we can’t wait to welcome you back for another visit.
Incredibly kind staff and exceptionally detailed care for my pet. I moved to a different borough and we still come here.

Thank you for your fantastic 5-star review, Chelsea! We’re thrilled that your visit was a great experience and that you felt well taken care of. We look forward to providing the same high level of care at your next visit to The Village Veterinarian!

I've been very happy here.  Took my last dog well past his estimated lifespan, and now a few visits into my current one. Both big bruiser mastiffs.   I think the most important factor is their flexibility to owner decisions. We all want the best of course, but there are financial limits for many, and all veterinary care in the city is pricy. They will guide you to the best decision without predjudice.

We've been taking my dog and cat here for several years. They take great care of our animals and the staff is always helpful and friendly. My only complaint is the vets on staff seem to be a rotating cast of characters, so you see a new doctor nearly every time you come in. It can make dealing with any ongoing issues a challenge, as you have to explain details over and over again.
Price switch. They waited until two days before the appointment to tell me the full cost. Absolutely unethical.

We’re so grateful for your 5-star review, Melvin! Our team at The Village Veterinarian is dedicated to giving pets the best care, and it’s wonderful to know we made a difference for you. We hope to see you and your pet again soon!

First visit today with Village Vet & I am so pleased with the care my kitty, Lilly received. The receptionists are friendly and warm, Juan the technician is a cat whisperer and handled Lilly with compassionate care and Dr. Moore is experienced, low key and super nice. My former vet hospital closed and I am happy to find a wonderful new one! 😻

Village Veterinarian is the kindest, most professional, and most hospitable vet I have ever visited. I took my cat here for a checkup, and every part of the process was exceptional. The signup and appointment booking was super easy, the front desk staff was extremely welcoming and helpful, and the nurses and Dr. Reyes were all incredible and treated my pet with love and attention. I feel extremely confident that he received (and will continue to receive) the best care by this cheerful team, and I would recommend this vet to anyone in the five boroughs! Thanks again! - Jack & Cheese

Upon check in I was told to go to exam room2. I wasn’t aware that this room was also the break room for employees there because Carole was enjoying her lunch. She left the container lid on the exam table. No greeting from her when entering the room and barely any acknowledgement.

I think it’s very unsanitary and a lack of concern for pets and humans who may be allergic to whatever she was eating. Also, the room didn’t wasn’t clean. The table scale had wet paper on it.

We are then moved to exam room 1 the nicer room we could say. We then meet a new veterinarian we have never seen before. She might be a good vet but i didn’t like my interaction with her, she came across as judgey and did not inform me as we went along what each additional test would cost.

Unfortunately before leaving I had to interact with Carole again. She has an attitude and tone problem which I didn’t care for.

Also noticed Carole interaction with the vet was rude to.

The vet tech was nice as was the receptionist.
Had a good experience.  Vet and staff knowledgeble and helpful, answered all my questions.  Would recommend.
KarryAnn is very professional, accommodating, and welcoming! 🤗 …

Experience was great. My dog was comfortable with the staff and the staff was extremely nice. Eddie the technician was gentle with getting my huge dog on the table. Dr. moscovich was very informative and giving me Gambit lots of kisses which had him wagging even after the vaccines and bloodwork.
—- corporate took over. Now they just suck!

Very unprofessional over the phone and rude. I have been there one other time and the experience felt unwelcome and the Vet was extremely impersonal. I have a Shiba, which any Vet knows is safer to be muzzled when examined for reactive purposes. They refused to see her for allergies unless she was sedated. I found a new vet where she doesn’t need to be muzzled and they’re extremely personable right down the street. No idea how you can treat people this way when there’s so much competition and friendlier options for your pets.

Your 5-star review truly made our day, Energymaster! It means the world to us that you trust The Village Veterinarian with your pet’s care. We’ll continue working hard to provide exceptional service and look forward to seeing you both again soon.

The Village Veterinarian and Dr. Mohr are absolutely amazing! Our kitty was incredibly stressed, but Dr. Mohr and her entire staff treated her with such compassion, dignity, and respect. They went above and beyond to make our kitty as …

A Heartbreaking Experience at Village Vet

We were loyal clients of Village Vet in NYC’s East Village since 2016, when we …

i took my three-month-old kitten here to get dewormed, because i thought he had worms. they told me that it was possible he had an incurable illness, and he needed an x-ray and a ton of diagnostics. it was over $1000. they said his liver …
I had posted a review a while ago, but I'm now noticing there was an error and it never posted :-( …
Amazing staff and the community appreciates you all.

Compassion!
I went to this vet with my 15-year-old cat who was suffering and today I received his paw print and a condolence card which I didn’t expect but I very much …
